The IPI setting is motivated by the scenario of detecting AI-generated academic reviews, where conference organizers might embed watermarking instructions in submitted papers, which are then picked up by LLMs used by reviewers. The authors evaluate the proposed ICW methods across various criteria, including detection accuracy, robustness against text transformations, and the impact on text quality.
